components.content:
- A round of Clan Hunting starts on Tuesday and lasts 7 days.
- Each clan member can participate in Clan Hunt once per day (the member must be in the clan for 24 hours before participating). After completing a hunt, the member receives rewards based on the damage dealt in that hunt.
- Progress rewards unlock when the total damages reach certain milestones. Clan members must be in the clan before the rewards unlock to be eligible to claim the rewards.
- Progress rewards may be one of 5 tiers, depending on the total damage in the previous two rounds.
